title: Muhammad E Possible NDE 7194
content: I could not sleep and finally at approximately 3-4 am, the 29th of April 2014, I fell asleep. I saw entities that looked like humans but weren’t human. They had white clothes and their faces did not look human. They looked like fluorescent light; they were bright. In my sleep, I felt I was at my grandmother’s house. I could see a hole on my forehead like a bullet target. But there was no blood. The white entities were not all different heights and they had surrounded me. One of them was opposite me in the air near the roof. They said they were here to take me away. They wanted me not to take any more breaths and I listened to them and saw a bright light come in from the direction of the door in the room. All around me was movement. There was another light coming in front of me, lower than the roof. It was coming though the wall exactly where the entities were standing, but all of a sudden, the bright light ended. The entities spoke again telling me ‘do not take any more breaths we want to take you with us’. I again stopped my breathing and the entities appeared again. This time I felt light and I saw myself as the bright light. I was floating up towards the tunnel of light. I heard voices of entities who were calling me. A lift appeared in the room and two entities came out of the lift. All the light ended and the tunnel was no longer. But the entities of light were still there. They said ‘don’t take any breaths’. The two that came out of the lift were like human but you could not see their faces. Just a red and blue light, like a spark, were their faces. This was around 8:00-8:30am in the morning. The night before at 7pm I had taken a tablet and around 12 pm ate dinner. At 2 am, my blood pressure went up.

arrival.other_being_detail: Entities that looked like humans but weren’t human; wore white clothes; faces did not look human; looked like fluorescent light/bright. Two later entities had faces described as red and blue light like a spark.

environment.environment_other_detail: Felt he was at his grandmother’s house; light came in from the direction of the door; another light came through the wall; entities were near the roof; a lift appeared in the room.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Occurred while asleep after taking a tablet the night before; reported blood pressure went up at 2 am; involved intentionally stopping breathing after entities told him not to breathe.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: A lift appeared in the room and two entities came out of it; perceived hole on forehead like a bullet target without blood; entities repeatedly instructed him not to breathe and said they were there to take him away.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience occurred during sleep; entities appeared first, then bright lights, then he became light and floated toward a tunnel; later the tunnel/light ended while entities remained; a lift appeared with two additional entities.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Entities appeared, then disappeared when light/tunnel ended, then appeared again when he stopped breathing again.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A lift/elevator appeared in the room and two entities emerged; two entities had faces described only as red and blue light like a spark; perceived a hole on his forehead like a bullet target with no blood; repeated instruction from entities to stop breathing so they could take him away.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “do not take any more breaths we want to take you with us”
